english: Did you find the Black IS?
Yeah, finally found them!
They were lurking in stealth mode, but\nwe linked with Butei High's Informa observation satellite\nand confirmed them on video.
They actually gave permission?
Thanks to Shirayuki.\nThough Aria might've pulled strings behind the scenes.
I didn't. This time.
This time, huh...
If the enemy thinks they're hidden,\nthat means we can ambush them?
That'd be nice!
Houki-san, you will absolutely win!\nYou know what's needed for that,\ndon't you?
I know that a hundred times over.\nBelieve in everyone, don't overestimate myself.\nIf I do that, surely...!
It'll be fine. If we fight trusting each other\nand giving our all,\nthere's no way we'll lose!
For that, I must stay calm.\nThat's what makes one strong... I've learned that.
The way of the sword is observation.\nTo discern everything about your opponent,\nkeep your heart calm...
That's what I taught Hibiki.\nWhat good am I if I can't do it myself...!
Your Akatsubaki's strike\ndoesn't need wild swinging.\nAim for one decisive blow.
I'll create\nas many chances as you need\nfor that!
Yeah, I'm counting on you.
All right! Let's confirm.\nVanguard: me and Houki.
Always be aware of each other's positions,\nand don't spread out too far so you can back each other up.\nThat'll make it hard for them to attack too.
I'll handle support with Laura-san.
I'll force them to dodge with gunfire,\nthen press the attack to create openings.
I'll do suppression with my many weapons\nand defense with my shield-\noffense and defense support.
Plus skirmishing.\nWith your dexterity, you'll be fine, right?
Yeah, leave it to me!
And those of us without IS units\nwill mop up the non-IS enemies.\nWe won't let them get in your way!
Delaying traps are my specialty.\nLeave it to me!
I'm the perfect one\nto take on Lovely-chan's lot!
Putting your taste aside,\nyou're not wrong about that.
I really wanna rampage together,\nbut I'd just get in the way of an IS-vs-IS battle,\nso it can't be helped.
Dividing roles is importantt.
Shirayuki and [CLAUDE] will nurse Hibiki, then.
No, I'm going along.\nShirayuki-san said those deploying\nneed healing too, so I should go.
That's true.\nIt's a burden on Shirayuki,\nbut I'll have you come.
Yes.
Everyone, thank you, truly.
Save those words until we win!
Honestly, you're jumping the gun.
S-sorry...\nI just don't feel like we'll lose...
An honest Houki-chan is nice.
Stop it, don't tease me!
Hibiki-chan's influence, maybe?
That... I can't deny...
Then, morale's high-\nlet's move out!
Yeah!
//Battle map: forest.\n//The grouped-up Black IS and grunts.
//Electronic sound.
Hm, this reaction is...!
//Attack effects hit several grunts. Defeated.
First volley, all hits!\nNot bad, nice shooting.
Fufun! Of course!
An ambush!
//An explosion before Black Houki and Black Rin as they try to move forward.
Tch!
Whoops, I won't let you get close that easily!
Then go!
//Enemy grunts advance, but Houki and Rin appear and instantly kill them.
Useless! Like that'd work on us!
I won't lose this time!!
I'll turn the tables on you!
//Battle begins.\n//Event at the start of turn 2.
Houki, your energy!?
Still plenty.\nHow's your shield energy, Rin?
I'm fine! Let's keep this up!
At this rate we won't go down easily.
This feels good!
Offense-defense balance is good!
Hmph...!
//The following line when Black Houki is defeated.
You've done it!
//The following line when Black Rin is defeated.
These guys!
//The following line when Black Charlotte is defeated.
I'll withdraw for now.
//The following line when Black Cecilia is defeated.
Tch, my shield energy...
//The following line when Black Laura is defeated.
This is as far as I go.
//Event after defeating 4 Black IS units.
One... more!
All right, let's push through!
We've come this far!
Let's finish this in one go!
Hm!? Wait! Something's coming!!
//At that moment, all IS units are attacked.
Guuh! Wh-what was...?
//Kei appears near the enemy IS.
Combat area, scan... no anomalies.
Kei!?
At this timing...!
That teleportation ability is way too convenient!
You, why are you here...!
4th-gen IS, Akatsubaki, is a research target.\nJudged to possess technology, specs,\nand further secrets unknown to me.
So I'm the target!?
Resistance is futile.\nContinuing combat should already be difficult.
Who'd ever surrender!
I warned you it was futile.\nTarget locked.\nShall I commence combat?
Obviously!
No choice but to fight.
This thing attacked indiscriminately in Europe!\nEven if we handed over the Akatsubaki,\nit wouldn't quietly go home!
Polite act or not, a robber is a robber!\nI won't allow it!
//Battle resumes.\n//Event when Kei is attacked.
Damage minimal. Continuing combat.
Tch, at this rate...!
Not just the Akatsubaki... everyone's energy\nand shields are already depleted...!
That doesn't mean we can run!
Attack, commencing.
Here it comes!!
There's only one of her!\nWe can't let her have her way so easily!
//Kei damages all 5 IS units with an area attack.
Guaaah!!
What is this!?
I can't block it...!
If another one of those comes!!
End.
Damn it!!
//Kei enters firing stance for an area attack.
Akatsubaki... is this really all your power?\nNo, there must be more...!\nPower to protect my comrades, my friends...!!
Our true power, together!!
//Electronic sound.
//Warning sound.
Sensor reaction, high energy detected.\nSource is...
//The Akatsubaki's Kenran Butou activates, fully restoring the Akatsubaki.
This is...!?\nThe Akatsubaki's energy is recovering...!?
Kenran Butou...?\nThis is the Akatsubaki's one-off ability!?
Wh-what is this...!?
The Akatsubaki's turning gold!?
Everyone! Take this!!
//Kenran Butou's effect fully heals all IS units.
What!? My energy...?
It's recovering...
We can do this! We can still fight with this!!
The real fight starts here!!
Scan initiated... error, analysis impossible.\nEnergy source unidentifiable.\nDetermined: unknown. Determined: unknown. Determined: unknown.
Reform the formation!
Roger!
Houki and Rin, left and right!\nI'll hold the front!
Here I go! Blue Tears!
//Houki and Rin spread left and right, Charlotte in front, Cecilia and Laura behind to either side. A W formation like Cassiopeia.
Round two begins!
I won't lose!
//Battle resumes.\n//Event after set turns or after dealing set damage to Kei.
Further data collection judged unnecessary.\nKenran Butou: true nature unknown.\nWill seek an opportunity to trigger it again.
//Kei retreats. The entire enemy army retreats.
Haa, haa, haa... did we win?
Yeah, well done.
I wondered how it'd turn out, though.
I'm glad everyone's safe.
That was a thrilling matchh!
Thank goodness...
//End of battle.
(Now, I managed to get a result\nI can face Hibiki with, but what should I report?\nIf she still hasn't regained consciousness...)
(Ngh... wouldn't it be weird to report\n"we won" to an unconscious Hibiki?\nWh-what face do I make, what do I say...?)
//Hibiki enters from behind Houki. Houki's portrait moves to the opposite side.
Huh? Houki-chan, welcome back!
Hyeh!? Hibiki!? Why are you here!?\nWeren't you on strict bed rest!?
...Hm? What are those rice balls in both hands?
Well, I was asleep for a while,\nso I got hungry...\nWant some too, Houki-chan?
Want some?... You were\ncritically unconscious!\nWhat is going on!?
Shh, Shirayuki-san, who's been nursing me all this time,\nis finally asleep from exhaustion.\nLet's be quiet so we don't wake her, okay?
Thank goodness...\nI was so afraid you'd never wake up again...\nI...!
Sorry for worrying you.
Actually, my body isn't normal-\nI'm a fusion with relic fragments inside me,\nso I heal really fast.
I don't think I'm immortal or anything,\nb-but I'll be fine if I try hard.\nEhehe...
Nobody told me that!\nNo-even if your body's tough,\nthat recklessness is not okay!!
Houki-chan...
No-I know I'm the one\nwho was reckless and caused trouble!\nIt's all my fault! I'm sorry!!
...Then, can I ask\njust one thing?
What is it? Ask me anything!\nI'll do whatever it is!
Really?\nThen let's eat rice balls together!
...That's your request?
Yeah! Here, pickled-plum rice ball.
...I always seem to be receiving from you, Hibiki.
That's not true!\nI've gotten plenty\nfrom you too!
When I went to save you, Houki-chan,\nI was desperate-I was probably giving it my all.
Mastering power is hard,\nbut in that moment, I felt like I did it.\nI think that's why I healed so fast.
So that's how you were saved...
...Probably!
Probably!? How careless!!
Sorry, I don't really get it.\nBut all I was thinking was\nthat I wanted to save you, Houki-chan.
I see... perhaps strange power emerges\nat times like that.\nI just experienced it myself.
Really?
Yes...!
//Fade to black.\n//Background: boss-hideout-like place.
Hiya, Mii-mii-chan!\nWanna do something fun with Riko?
Hweh? Sure!\nMii's free, so I'll hang out with you!\nIf it's boring, it's zap-zap time, okay?
It's fine! I thought of something fun!\nI call it: Detective Doronbo play!
What's that? Weird!
I'm gonna act like Detective Doronbo\nand ask questions, and you\nact like the culprit and tell lies!
I just have to lie?\nSounds fun!
Okay, here we go. Um, Mii-san.\nI'm Doronbo from Homicide.\nMy wife's a fan of yours, you see.
Ahaha, you're weirdd!
Well, it's a simple question,\nso just answer it quick.
Have you ever received\na present from Yi Wu?
Nope!
(Good, that's a lie.\nMii has received some gift from Yi Wu.)
I see. Those Yi Wu folks\nmust be quite the cheapskates.
Then, do you know why\nI was dispatched from Yi Wu?
Umm, because it looked fun?
(That's a lie too. So she knows\nthe reason I'm working under them.)
Hahaha! Fun, yes. So fun!\nFor me it's like a treasure hunt.
So, do you know about my treasure?
I know! It's a game, right!\nOne of those gal-game things?
(A lie too. My treasure isn't a game.\nWhich means she really does know\nwhat treasure I'm looking for!)
Yes, that's it!\nNow listen carefully.\nIs my treasure's location... here?
Gal-games would be\nat a game shop, I thinkk?
(Since the game was a lie,\nthe game-shop answer is a lie too.\nAnd the treasure isn't here right now.)
I see! Quite right!\nAnd that game shop-\nis it in this world?
Game shops are everywheree!
(A lie. Which means the place\nwhere my treasure is must be in this world...!)
Haha, you got me there!\nI concede, I surrender.\nWell then, excuse me.
Hweh? Over?\nRiko's terrible acting was funny,\nbut where's the punchline?
Shouldn't it end with "I'm the culprit!"\nand getting caught?\nHeeey! Riko! Heeey!
//Fade to black.\n//Background: outdoors.
Kufufu! Mii told her lies\nproperly...
The mini lie detector Riko got at Gamers,\nmade by Dejiko.\nWith this, I can tell truth from lies in everything Mii says!
Thanks to it, I figured it out!\nWhat Riko's looking for\nis in this world...!
The rest is easy.\nIf I investigate the places Mii's involved with,\nI can narrow down where it is.
Just a little more... then I can... Ormes...!
//Fade to black.\n//Background: boss-hideout-like place.
Mii, what was the meaning of that?
Eh, whatever!
...Incomprehensible.
More importantly, Kei-chan, empty-handed?\nWhat about the Akatsubaki? Did you break it?
Unknown energy emitted from the Akatsubaki.\nJudged it should be analyzed first.
Hmm, I thought IS units\nwould be the easiest.
That perception needs revising.
Furude Rika's power, Dr. Shinigami's power,\nthe Amanotsukai's power, and the IS's...\nthe Akatsubaki's power.
All of them: principles unknown.\nError, incomprehensible...
Fufuun! That's what makes it interesting!
//END
